name: DR Congo (east)
value: Kivu clashes; no city changed hands
summary: Fighting continues in the Kivus without major gains; talks stalled as Ebola and cholera spread
state: Critical Threats' Congo War Security Review of 28 Oct reports continued clashes between the army and AFC/M23 in North and South Kivu without a major city changing hands. Crisis Group tracks stalled talks under the August roadmap, and searches on 6 Nov found no capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to North and South Kivu. Fighting hampers the Ebola and cholera response in the east.
rubric_hit: Watch: active fighting, no capture of a major city or interstate clash

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.
